transcript.text: Hi, this is Austin, a virtual health insurance advisor with Darwix Health. This call is recorded for quality and compliance purposes. Is it okay if we continue?
Yes, that's fine.
Thank you. How can I help you today? I can answer questions about our health plans, or check which plan might fit you.
Hi, I'm looking for health insurance for me and my wife.
Thanks for letting me know. I can help you find a plan that fits your needs. May I ask how old you are?
Thanks, 42 is noted. Which state do you live in?
We live in Austin, Texas.
Thanks, Texas is noted. Does anyone who would be covered use tobacco?
Just the two of us.
Thanks, that is noted. Does anyone who would be covered use tobacco?
How much does the Family Shield plan cost?

Just so you know, final coverage and premiums are subject to medical underwriting and depend on verified medical history. Family Shield starts from $520 per month. Final premiums depend on age, location, and underwriting results. Does anyone who would be covered use tobacco?
No, neither of us smokes.
Thanks, that is noted. Do you, or anyone who would be covered, have any current medical conditions? You're welcome to skip this one.
No, we're both healthy.
Thanks for sharing that. I have all the details I need to check which plans might fit. Do you have any health insurance right now?
No, I lost my coverage when I left my job.
Thanks for letting me know. I have all the information I need to check which plans might fit for you and your spouse. What's the best time for a licensed advisor to call you back with a quote?
Weekday evenings after 6 would be best.
Weekday evenings after 6 works for me. I will have a licensed advisor call you then with your quote. And do I have your permission for Darwix Health to contact you about your quote?
Yes, that's fine.

Thanks for confirming. A licensed advisor will call you on a weekday evening after 6 with your quote. Thank you, that's everything I need. Based on what you've told me, you may be a fit for Essential Care or Family Shield. A licensed advisor will call you with a personalized quote. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's all. Thanks!
You're welcome. Have a great day!
